title: Harbour depth d = 5 + 3 sin(πt/6)
caption: The depth swings 3 m either side of 5 m. One full cycle takes 2π ÷ (π/6) = 12 hours, so the peaks at t = 3 and t = 15 are 12 hours apart, and the maximum depth is 5 + 3 = 8 m.
alt: A wave of depth against time for 24 hours, with its peaks of 8 m at 3 and 15 hours, troughs of 2 m, and an arrow marking the period of 12 hours.
description: The depth is d = 5 + 3 sin(πt/6), centred on 5 m with amplitude 3 m.
The maximum occurs when sin = 1: d = 5 + 3 = 8 m, first at t = 3 hours.

checks.name: the first maximum is 8 m at t = 3
the next maximum is at t = 15, 12 hours later
after one period the depth is back to 5 m
